name: Air-Fryer Tofu Tikka
ingredients: 250 g extra-firm tofu, pressed for 15 minutes and cubed
½ tsp each chilli powder and ajwain
steps: Mix the soy yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, spices, oil, lemon and salt. Coat the tofu and capsicum and rest for 30 minutes.
Arrange the tofu and capsicum in a single layer, and cook for 12 minutes, shaking the basket at 6 minutes.
Finish with chaat masala and lemon.
note: Pressing the tofu removes water so it browns and turns firm rather than steaming.
